title: expand_url_template undocumented behavior for percent-encoding and unknown variables
description: expand_url_template is pub(crate) and its behavior for two edge cases is not documented and not tested: (1) what happens when a variable name in vars does not appear in the template (silently no-op — benign but surprising), and (2) what happens when the template contains a variable not in vars (leaves literal '{name}' in URL — silently wrong, filed separately as correctness bug). The percent-encoding behavior is documented in the function doc, but the interaction with RFC 6570 Level-1 semantics (undefined variable = empty string) is documented only in a code comment inside download_blob, not in expand_url_template itself. A caller using expand_url_template directly will not know the undefined-variable-expands-to-empty convention unless they read the call site. Move the RFC 6570 behavior documentation into the function doc.
